# Repo map

<!-- generated by the folder-explore skill; run it again after moving files -->
<!-- folder-explore: commit=no-git generated=2026-09-22 -->

Materials for Bobby Bridges's ~60-minute AI talk (30 min talk + 30 min discussion) for
elderly residents of Brookdale assisted living. Deliverable is a self-contained HTML slide
deck plus the Python that generates its figures.

## Start here
- [README.md](README.md) — what the repo is, how to run the talk, and a folder-by-folder guide.
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md) — project context, audience, timing, deck/chart workflow, contrast rules.
- [talkplan.md](talkplan.md) — Bobby's source outline (titles, content, dialogue); narrative source of truth.
- [slides/index.html](slides/index.html) — the finished deck; open in a browser, press `S` for the speaker-notes window.
- [docs/research-notes.md](docs/research-notes.md) — every sourced fact/stat/headline used, with citations.

## (root)
Planning docs, the theme reference, and brand assets.

- [talkplan.md](talkplan.md) — Bobby's original slide-by-slide outline with intended dialogue; refine, don't discard.
- [2026-09-04-safecare-kickoff.html](2026-09-04-safecare-kickoff.html) — reference deck whose look the talk copies (navy/white slides, Newsreader + IBM Plex, yellow accent). Theme source of truth.
- [notes.md](notes.md) — container tooling notes (RTK proxy, Headroom, git creds); unrelated to talk content.
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md) — project brief + coding standards; read before editing anything here.

## aise-logos/
AI Sweden logo source files (SVG). The deck inlines the logo in JS, so these are just originals. `[binary]`

- [dark blue.svg](aise-logos/AI%20Sweden%20-%20logo%20-%20dark%20blue.svg), [yellow on blue.svg](aise-logos/AI%20Sweden%20-%20logo%20-%20yellow%20on%20blue.svg), [yellow.svg](aise-logos/AI%20Sweden%20-%20logo%20-%20yellow.svg) — brand variants. `[binary]`

## slides/
The deck: one self-contained `index.html` (no framework). Navy/light `.slide` sections,
inline CSS + nav/speaker-notes JS, offline fonts.

- [index.html](slides/index.html) — all 16 slides + hidden per-slide `<div class="notes">` dialogue; `S`=notes window, `F`=fullscreen, ←/→=nav. THE deliverable.
- [fonts.css](slides/fonts.css) — @font-face for the vendored woff2 (offline).
- fonts/ — 6 vendored woff2 files (Newsreader, IBM Plex Sans/Mono, latin subset). `[binary]`
- assets/ — images shown on slides. `[binary]`:
  - line-fit.gif (regression animation; now draws all sales faintly + subset error bars), house-scatter.png (data-only scatter), metr-actual-plot.png + metr-exp.png (two METR figures, the agents-trend slide), ai-adoption.png (frontier-vs-average firms, questions slide), tree-ai.png (parent/child, slide 3), sycamore (JPEG, slide 2), tumor.jpg (scan, slide 2).
- The deck is **18 slides** (agents split into: real METR plot, annotated METR plot, then examples).

## charts/
Python (managed with `uv`; use the 3.12 `.venv`, not system 3.14) that generates the deck's
figures into `charts/out/`, then copied into `slides/assets/`.

- [line_fit.py](charts/line_fit.py) — gradient-descent line fit to Ames prices → `out/line-fit.gif`; start line deliberately poor so the fit visibly "walks."
- [house_scatter.py](charts/house_scatter.py) — same data, points only → `out/house-scatter.png`; imports `load_data` from line_fit.
- [metr_plot.py](charts/metr_plot.py) — recreation of METR's trend from their yaml; kept as provenance only (deck shows METR's official PNG instead).
- out/ — rendered figures. `[binary]`
- data/ — downloaded inputs (AmesHousing.txt, metr_benchmark_results_1_1.yaml); regenerated on demand.

## backups/
Timestamped snapshots for quick revert (e.g. `2026-09-22/` holds the pre-change
`index.html`, `line_fit.py`, and `line-fit.gif`). Copy a file back to restore.

## docs/
- [research-notes.md](docs/research-notes.md) — sourced facts for footnotes/notes: headlines, agent-risk examples (incl. user-supplied Mythos & HuggingFace items), adoption/energy/water stats, dataset URLs.
- [repo-map.md](docs/repo-map.md) — this file.
